runs.question: How can I pay my fees online?
runs.answer:
You can pay your fees online using PayPoint, the university's payment page, with a credit or debit card. There is a surcharge of 0.9 per cent for card payments. Alternatively, you can use BPAY from your bank account with the biller code and reference number on your fee statement, which has no surcharge. 

For more details, visit: [Fees | Current Students | Wattlebrook University](https://www.wattlebrook.example/students/fees/).
